Q1: Which branch should the fix be implemented against?
Choices:
A. PR #6786's head branch `ai/issue-6782`, which has the failing test (head `64251aea3161e7764df0cb02bf57cae98fef3040`). Fix the test there so PR #6786's CI goes green. (RECOMMENDED)

C. Close this issue as superseded and let PR #6786's own review/autofix loop fix the test on its branch.
